pick.headline: Saddam meets US Ambassador April Glaspie
pick.fbis: The Near East & South Asia Daily Report of July 25, 1990, carried a one-line Baghdad INA report that Saddam Husayn had summoned US Ambassador April Glaspie, with Tariq Aziz present, beside an AL-QADISIYAH editorial attacking Kuwait's "hostile behavior."

evidence.title: FBIS Daily Report: Near East & South Asia, No. 143, 25 July 1990
evidence.snippet: 2 IRAQ Saddam Reportedly Sammons U.S. Ambassador 4JN2507121390 Baghdad INA in English 1205 GMT 25 Jul 90 [Text] Baghdad. July 25. INA—President Saddam Husayn today summoned ambassador of the United States April C. Glaspie. The audience was attended by Mr. Tariq ‘Aziz deputy premier and foreign minister. alternates.headline: Israel launches Operation Accountability in Lebanon
alternates.fbis: The Near East & South Asia Daily Report of July 26, 1993, carried Cairo radio on the Arab League condemning a seventh day of Israeli bombardment of south Lebanon, and IDF Radio on Haydar Abd-al-Shafi calling the attack an attempt to demolish the peace process.

alternates.headline: Washington Declaration ends Jordan-Israel state of war
alternates.fbis: The Near East & South Asia Daily Report of July 25, 1994, carried the run-up to the Washington meeting: Amman radio on King Husayn's arrival, a Monte Carlo report on Israeli demands for Jordanian army cuts, and Israel Radio quoting Rabin that a peace treaty was not yet under discussion.
